'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Australian Government|Australian]] [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Anthony Albanese]] announces a [[Australian dollar|AU$]]110 million [[military aid]] package to [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2023/jun/26/australia-ukraine-support-funding-110m-military-assistance-vehicles-ammunition (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] recapture the uninhabited village of [[Rivnopil, Velyka Novosilka settlement hromada, Volnovakha Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Rivnopil]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], according to Deputy Defence Minister [[Hanna Maliar]], the ninth in the past month. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-it-has-retaken-southeastern-village-rivnopil-2023-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] take control of the main [[Law enforcement in Sudan|police]] base in [[Khartoum]], seizing a large amount of [[military equipment]] and [[ammunition]], including 160 [[pickup truck]]s, 75 [[armoured personnel carrier]]s, and 27 tanks. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/26/sudan-paramilitary-force-reportedly-makes-gains-in-khartoum-as-fighting-surges (''The Guardian'')]
**The [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North]] attacks the town of [[Kurmuk]] in [[Blue Nile (state)|Blue Nile]], [[Sudan]], prompting hundreds of [[civilian]]s to flee across [[Ethiopia–Sudan border|the border]] to [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/reports-fighting-sudans-southeast-after-rsf-advance-khartoum-2023-06-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Turkish economic crisis (2018–current)|Turkish economic crisis]]
**The [[Turkish lira]] falls to a record low against the [[United States dollar]], while the [[Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey|central bank]] stops using its reserves to support the lira. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/currencies/turkey-lira-new-low-after-rollback-bank-rules-2023-06-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pakistan ration distribution stampedes]]
**Twenty-one people are injured in a [[stampede]] during the disbursement of funds for the [[Benazir Income Support Programme]] in [[Karachi]], [[Sindh]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2023/06/26/stampede-at-karachi-bisp-disbursement-leaves-21-women-wounded/ (Pakistan Today)]
*Ten people are killed by [[lightning strike]]s in [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-lightning-rains-deaths-7c14e5502e6d7414e67951abccdfbb40 (AP)]
*Seven people die from drinking [[Moonshine|bootleg alcohol]] in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]]. [https://iranwire.com/en/news/117914-alcohol-poisoning-claims-more-lives-in-iran/ (Iranwire)]
*Ten people are killed, four others are injured, and an unknown number of people are trapped when a 14-story apartment [[building collapse]]s in [[Alexandria]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/503860.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]
*One person is killed and six others are injured after a fire breaks out in a nickel smelting factory in [[Central Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blaze-indonesian-nickel-smelter-kills-worker-wounds-6-2023-06-28/ (Reuters)]
'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Sri Lanka]]n [[Department of Wildlife Conservation (Sri Lanka)|Department of Wildlife Conservation]] cancels plans to export about 100,000 [[Endangered species (IUCN status)|endangered]] [[toque macaque]] [[Old World monkey]]s to China after several [[environmentalist]]s initiated legal action in the [[Court of Appeal of Sri Lanka|Court of Appeal]] against the export. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/06/27/23/cash-strapped-sri-lanka-scraps-plan-to-export-100000-endangered-monkeys (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Germany–Lithuania relations]]
**[[List of German defence ministers|German Defense Minister]] [[Boris Pistorius]] announces that [[Germany]] will permanently station 4,000 [[German Army|troops]] in [[Lithuania]] in order to help secure [[NATO]]'s eastern flank. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-to-station-4000-troops-permanently-in-lithuania/a-66031051 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Toronto mayoral by-election]]
**Former [[New Democratic Party]] [[Member of Parliament (Canada)|Member of Parliament]] [[Olivia Chow]] is elected [[Mayor of Toronto]], defeating former city councillor [[Ana Bailão]], becoming the city's first non-White mayor. She replaces [[John Tory]], who [[resign]]ed in February after revealing he had an [[extra-marital]] [[affair]] with a staffer. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-66026811 (BBC News)]
